text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and would love to help with your Canva Facebook ads work.

I have 6 years of experience in machine learning and automation, and while my main background is technical, I’m comfortable working carefully with content workflows and image-based tasks. In a recent project, I built a call centre speech analytics pipeline that transcribes calls, separates agent and customer speech, and writes a QA summary for every call. That system processed 2,300 hours of calls and raised QA coverage from 3% to 100%.

For your project, I can help with removing and adding logos and making small photo alterations from your supplier assets, with an eye toward consistency and clean presentation. I’m also open to a longer-term arrangement if you need ongoing support.

If you’d like, I can start with a few sample edits so you can review my style.
